# A well-known 5x5 magic square (Siamese method / de la Loubere):
# Starting with 1 in the middle of the top row
def siamese_magic(n):
    magic = [[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
    i, j = 0, n//2
    for num in range(1, n*n+1):
        magic[i][j] = num
        ni, nj = (i-1)%n, (j+1)%n
        if magic[ni][nj]:
            i = (i+1)%n
        else:
            i, j = ni, nj
    return magic
